notes.zh: 「尋寶」改為「掉寶率」：每 +1% = 裝備掉落機率 +1%，另加 +0.5% 稀有度（取代經驗／金幣加成）。
notes.en: "Treasure find" became "drop rate": every +1% = +1% item drop chance plus +0.5% rarity (replacing the XP / gold bonus).

notes.zh: 所有掉落（經驗、金幣、裝備、技能珠）都會自動飛去你身上（補血球只喺唔夠血時先飛）；打低 Boss 後地上剩低嘅嘢自動拾取，背包滿就入倉庫；「拾取範圍」改為「尋寶」：經驗同金幣各加一半。
notes.en: Every drop (XP, gold, items, orbs) now flies to you (heal orbs only when you're hurt); after a boss, anything left on the ground is collected automatically, overflow goes to the stash; "pickup radius" became "treasure find": half as XP and half as gold.

notes.zh: 位移技能改為自己控制（E／右鍵／手機「位移」掣，向住移動方向）；光環唔再觸發「踏地施放」；同款技能珠疊埋一格（×N），背包上限計格數；裝備圖示每件傳奇唔同色、套裝綠色、遠古／太古有邊框同標記，倉庫可以先睇詳情先搬；新遊戲 icon。
notes.en: Movement skills are now player-controlled (E / right-click / touch Move button, toward your movement); auras no longer fire Cast on Zone Enter; identical orbs stack in one cell (×N) and the bag counts cells; every legendary has its own icon colour, sets are green, ancient / primal get frames and badges, the stash shows details before moving; new game icon.

notes.zh: 躍擊同疾風突擊唔再瞬移：跳躍有弧線、衝刺會滑過去，到達先出傷害；敵人已經喺身邊就原地攻擊，唔會再閃嚟閃去。
notes.en: Leap Slam and Dash Strike no longer teleport: the leap arcs and the dash slides, damage lands on arrival; if the enemy is already next to you they hit in place instead of flickering around.

notes.zh: 終局更新（三）：全新音效系統——立體聲、迴響、42 種音效（暴擊、元素反應、精英、傳奇／套裝／遠古掉落、哥布林、神壇、Boss 預警、低血心跳…），每個區域、Boss、裂隙階級同 Boss 連戰都有自己嘅節奏音樂。
notes.en: Endgame update (3): new sound engine — stereo, echo, 42 sounds (crits, reactions, elites, legendary / set / ancient drops, goblin, shrines, boss warnings, low-life heartbeat…) and beat-driven music for every zone, bosses, rift tiers and boss rush.

notes.zh: 終局更新（二）：地形柱同區域地面（熔岩／冰面／虛空）、隨機事件（寶藏哥布林、詛咒神壇、精英群、力量神壇）、每局兩次強化卡、Boss 連戰模式＋排行榜。
notes.en: Endgame update (2): pillars and zone floors (lava / ice / void), random events (treasure goblin, cursed shrine, elite pack, power shrine), two boon picks per run, Boss Rush mode + leaderboard.

notes.zh: 終局更新（一）：裂隙階級（打爆機後無限挑戰＋排行榜）、遠古／太古裝備、4 套套裝（Boss 指定掉落）。
notes.en: Endgame update (1): Rift Tiers (endless post-game ladder + leaderboard), ancient / primal gear, 4 item sets (targeted boss drops).

notes.zh: 更新內容會自動跟網上更新。
notes.en: Patch notes now update online automatically.

notes.zh: 修正重新載入會跳去 itch.io 嘅問題；itch 頁面改為「開始玩」掣。
notes.en: Fixed reloading jumping to itch.io; the itch page is now a Play button.

notes.zh: 手機鏡頭拉近（設定可揀 1×／1.5×／2×）；能力值說明收入「？說明」。
notes.en: Closer camera on phones (1× / 1.5× / 2× in Options); attribute details moved behind "? Help".

notes.zh: 有新版本時自動重新載入。
notes.en: Reloads automatically when a new version is out.

notes.zh: 大螢幕介面放大；裝備背包精簡。
notes.en: Menus scale up on large monitors; tidier equipment bag.

notes.zh: 技能珠同裝備分開兩個畫面，技能珠畫面重新設計；雲端存檔自動同步；修正手機撳唔到「繼續」。
notes.en: Orbs and equipment are separate screens, redesigned orb screen; cloud saves auto-sync; fixed Continue not responding to taps on phones.

notes.zh: 村莊三個入口（主線傳送門、挑戰祭壇、榮譽石碑）；全螢幕同加入主畫面。
notes.en: Three village entrances (Zone Portal, Challenge Altar, Hall of Fame); fullscreen and Add to Home Screen.
Google / Discord sign-in and cloud saves.

notes.zh: 每日／每週裂隙、連續每日獎勵、活動同公告系統。
notes.en: Daily / weekly rifts, daily streak rewards, events and news.

notes.zh: 裂隙詞綴：出發前揀風險，換經驗、金幣同稀有度。
notes.en: Rift modifiers: pick risks for more XP, gold and rarity.
